pictures.name: QE1-Grumbling
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich hand-woven textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Evening in a village house: tax collectors in bright fine robes and poor outsiders in rough tunics laugh and eat together around a low table with bread and fish. Jesus, a man in a plain off-white robe with a soft brown mantle, shown ONLY from behind or as a far figure, his face never visible, sits among them, seen from behind. In the doorway, two religious leaders in pale fringed robes stand stiffly, frowning and whispering to each other. Warmth inside, judgment at the door.

No text, no letters, no logos, no modern objects. Open wilderness hills at dusk, a large flock of sheep grazing on a rocky slope. a shepherd in his thirties with a dark beard, a rough striped wool cloak and a wooden staff, stands among them counting, one hand raised, worry on his face as he looks out toward the darkening hills. Deep blue sky, first star. One is missing.

pictures.name: QE6-Today
pictures.prompt: Tall 9:16 contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike faces, rich textiles, deep blue shadows and warm gold lamplight, soft painterly brushwork, main subject in the middle of the frame. A modern setting painted in the same contemplative oil style, warm light, no readable text, no logos. A modern living room in the evening. A woman in her fifties sits on the arm of a sofa, phone to her ear, smiling warmly as if telling an old friend she was just thinking of them, a photo of old friends on the shelf beside her. Soft lamplight. Reaching out.
